name: Weather forecast
description: Current conditions and a five-day forecast from one of your Weather data sources. Your server fetches the weather itself; the template only lays it out.
author: ScreenTinker

params.name: weather
params.label: Weather data source
params.help: A data source of type Weather (Data Sources → New → Weather). Its location, units and language are set there.

params.name: location
params.label: Location name
params.help: The heading. Usually the city or the site's name.

params.name: units_label
params.label: Temperature suffix
params.help: Shown after every temperature: ° on its own, or °C / °F to match the data source.

params.name: timezone
params.label: Clock timezone
params.help: Leave empty to use the screen's own clock.

params.name: locale
params.label: Date language
params.help: For example en-GB or de-DE. Leave empty for the screen's language.
